source.symbol: Calendar view tablist initial selection and focusability
source.validation: Exact public Git source at the fixed comparison revision. Claims are static observations. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

text:
<div id="viewToggle" role="tablist" class="calview-toggle">
              <button id="calTabDay"
                      class="calview-toggle-item"
                      role="tab"
                      value="day"
                      tabindex="-1"
                      aria-controls="day-view"
                      aria-selected="false"
                      data-l10n-id="calendar-view-toggle-day"></button>
              <button id="calTabWeek"
                      class="calview-toggle-item"
                      role="tab"
                      value="week"
                      tabindex="0"
                      aria-controls="week-view"
                      aria-selected="true"
                      data-l10n-id="calendar-view-toggle-week"></button>
              <button id="calTabMultiweek"
                      class="calview-toggle-item"
                      role="tab"
                      value="multiweek"
                      tabindex="-1"
                      aria-controls="multiweek-view"
                      aria-selected="false"
                      data-l10n-id="calendar-view-toggle-multiweek"></button>
              <button id="calTabMonth"
                      class="calview-toggle-item"
                      role="tab"
                      value="month"
                      tabindex="-1"
                      aria-controls="month-view"
                      aria-selected="false"
                      data-l10n-id="calendar-view-toggle-month"></button>
